title: Operationalizing Declarative and Procedural Knowledge: a Benchmark on Logic Programming Petri Nets (LPPNs)
reasoning: The paper focuses on the computational performance and formal semantics of Logic Programming Petri Nets (LPPNs). While it discusses the use of LPPNs for modeling norms, law, and deontic positions, the benchmark itself is a technical evaluation of execution efficiency (time) across different net topologies, rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of ethics, morals, or religious systems.
